title: #eng: Q3 pricing rollout decision
text:
Alice Chen: After reviewing the churn data, we're going ahead with the Q3 pricing rollout on Tuesday July 28. Enterprise tier moves to $89/seat.

Bob Park: Confirmed. I'll update the billing service flags on Monday so we can smoke-test before the announcement.

Alice Chen: Great. Marketing wants the changelog draft by Friday -- I'll own that.
